bullets.text: Taylor Swift's Documentary Magic - **Taylor Swift**'s new docuseries revives the emotional essence of her **Eras Tour**.
UK Age Verification Push - The British government seeks to mandate **Apple** and **Google** to block nude photos without age verification.
Google Dark Web Report Ending - **Google** will discontinue its dark web report feature due to lack of actionable user guidance.
AirPods Max Still Leading - **Apple**'s **AirPods Max** remain top noise-canceling headphones, despite competition from newer models.
Kindle's AI Feature Launch - **Amazon** introduces the AI-powered 'Ask This Book' feature for its **Kindle** app to enhance reader engagement.
Ford's Battery Storage Shift - **Ford** pivots to a battery storage business, aiming to power data centers and the grid.
Lightspeed's Record Fundraise - **Lightspeed Venture Partners** raises a historic $9 billion, marking a significant milestone in venture capital.
Disney's OpenAI Partnership - **Disney**'s exclusive deal with **OpenAI** allows character use in AI content creation for one year.
